_comment: Claude Code settings for a Touchstone-aligned project. The branch guard refuses `git commit` on the default branch at the tool boundary, before the commit is attempted. Copy hooks/branch-guard.sh from the touchstone repo to hooks/branch-guard.sh in this project — the command below must resolve, or the guard silently never runs. User-specific overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored), which Claude Code merges on top of this file.
